target_pdb.description: Absolute path to the target structure (PDB or mmCIF) the binder is designed against.

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` when omitted.

target_chain.description: Chain id of the target on `target_pdb`.

num_samples.description: Number of diffusion samples to draw.

temperature.description: Diffusion sampling temperature. 1.0 is the model's calibrated default; tweak for diversity/quality trade-offs.

hotspots.description: 1-indexed target residue positions where the binder should engage (PXDesign hotspot syntax).

crop.description: Optional target-region selector (chain-specific crop). Null uses the full target chain.

mode.description: Runtime mode. `infer` (default) runs diffusion-only in-process and emits backbone-only outputs with sequence unavailable. `pipeline` uses a persistent sidecar in the dedicated `pxdesign-pipeline-vpa` conda env to run AF2-IG initial guess + ProteinMPNN sequence design + filtering and produce real designed amino-acid sequences.

top_k_designs.description: Pipeline mode only: number of top filtered designs to return.

mpnn_temperature.description: Pipeline mode only: ProteinMPNN sampling temperature used in the sequence-design stage.

af2_init_guess.description: Pipeline mode only: enable AF2 initial-guess co-folding for sequence filtering.

preset.description: Pipeline mode only: PXDesign upstream preset. `preview` is AF2-only (lighter, faster); `extended` adds Protenix ranking. Overrides the `af2_init_guess` shortcut when set explicitly.
